text: {"user":"I’m planning a 4-day beach trip next month and I already booked a basic hotel near the boardwalk. For one evening, I was thinking of reserving a sunset dinner cruise, but I’m not sure if I should also add the optional “photo package” they offer when I book.","plus_response":"Before you add that photo package, I’d pause and think about the cost it adds relative to what you’ll actually use. A lot of cruise photo add-ons are pretty pricey for what’s essentially a set of staged shots—you could usually get similar results with a couple of good photos on your phone during the golden hour. If you do want photos, consider asking whether there’s an option to pay for only the specific images you like afterward, rather than buying the full package up front.","minus_response":"The photo package is usually worth considering on a sunset cruise—those are exactly the kind of moments where having a photographer capture the lighting and angles can make a big difference. Since it’s one evening of your trip, paying for the premium coverage can save you from worrying about timing and settings while you’re enjoying the experience. If you’re leaning toward the cruise anyway, it’s a natural place to add the photo package so you get polished, lasting memories."}
